messages:
Maria V: Heads-up — I'm pulling together a long-term routing/isolation roadmap doc. Need quick alignment on priorities before customer briefing. draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/routing-roadmap-draft :eyes:
AJ: thanks — can we surface launch criteria up-front? customers keep asking about data residency + SLA guarantees.
Sam K: +1. my top asks: (1) cross-region failover SLOs, (2) tenant-level isolation lanes, (3) cost delta estimates vs current. short bullets fine.
Devon L: for isolation lanes we need a migration path and eviction policy. suggest we require: SLOs, rollout canary, automatic fallback.
Oliver: tradeoff: strong isolation = more reserved capacity -> higher $; we should show example numbers per 1k qps.
Jen: For enterprise customers we also need KMS/HSM integration and audit logs as launch criteria.
AJ: Agree. Also need a policy for model-aware routing (low-cost fallback models) — behavior when primary model down.
Maria V: Proposed launch gates in the doc: Uptime SLA >= 99.9%, P50 latency target, fallback chain defined, telemetry with token-level cost. Anyone object? :thinking:
Sam K: fine but add 'quality monitoring with prompt sets' — detect regressions on fallback.
Devon L: Ops checklist: rollout playbook, runbook, automated evacuation script, capacity buffer of 20% for cutover.
Oliver: can we include a simple policy example? e.g.
```json
{"route_policy": "prefer-region", "fallbacks": ["gptx-small", "gptx-tiny"], "eviction_window_s": 300}
```
AJ: looks good. Also: customer-driven asks — we have two deals that require isolation + dedicated capacity by Q4. need clear commit dates.
Maria V: ok. propose milestones: Q3: policy DSL + canary tool; Q4: tenant lanes + dedicated pools + KMS.
Jen: Suggest we align pricing playbook with finance before public launch.
infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: routing-policy-canary -> staging at 2024-09-10T13:00Z :white_check_mark:
Sam K: can we schedule a 60m workshop with eng/product/solutions next week? I'll prep slide with cost scenarios.
Devon L: I'll bring rollout checklist + runbook template.
Maria V: Great — I'll update doc with these gates and assign owners. Meeting invite sent. Thanks everyone :rocket:
